chunks: Then the believers will say: 'Are these the people who had sworn by God on solemn oath and said: "We are surely with you?" Wasted have been all their deeds, and losers they remain.'

key_terms.جَهْدَ أَيْمَانِهِمْ: with the strength of their oaths (firmly)

ai.seo_question: What do the believers say to the hypocrites in the Hereafter according to Surah Al-Ma'idah?
ai.summary: In the Shia exegetical tradition, this verse highlights the ultimate disillusionment of the faithful who, despite the hypocrites' solemn oaths of loyalty, witness their deeds rendered void due to hidden insincerity. It serves as a profound lesson on the distinction between outward conformity and inward conviction, emphasizing that true success lies in consistent faith rather than mere association. The 'loss' mentioned refers not only to the negation of good deeds but also to the eternal regret of those who prioritized social convenience over spiritual integrity.
